title: Nelly and Ashanti Hint at Possible Las Vegas Residency
htmlContent:
It's possible that Nelly and Ashanti will be bringing their signature style and chemistry to Las Vegas via a joint residency soon. The iconic rapper and R&B singer, who tied the knot last December after rekindling their longtime romance, hinted at the possibility of a concert during a recent interview with Entertainment Tonight.   An ET reporter at Nelly's 50th birthday celebration in Las Vegas inquired if the couple could consider a Vegas residency. Nelly's response suggested that fans could be excited.
“That’s funny that you say that,” he said . “There were talks not too long ago about that very thing. I’m not gonna say too much more, but hopefully everything continues the course. I love Vegas, she loves Vegas. We both love Vegas for very different reasons.”
Nelly and Ashanti's history is like the stuff of love stories. The couple started dating for over a decade before splitting in 2013. In a storybook twist, they rekindled their romance last year, and it ended with a private wedding ceremony in December. The couple celebrated another major milestone in July by welcoming their first child together, which added to their already joyful journey. A residency could be the perfect way for both artists to return to the spotlight and share their music with fans now that they are back on the scene. Nelly and Ashanti's shared musical legacy can be brought to life through a Las Vegas show, which would provide them with a unique platform to perform both their individual hits and possibly collaborate on stage. A Vegas residency would allow fans to experience the energy and passion of these two music icons in person, in the entertainment capital of the world. Nelly indicated that everything is set; now, it's only a matter of time before the details are revealed.
